thread:
Maya Rivers: FYI — NimbusRetail pilot usage collapsed overnight. Renewal in 4 weeks. They told AE their CTO is running a 2-week competitive POC (we're up against FlowGen). They also called out regressions on multi-turn QA. Need a fast triage and an offer to re-win.

Carlos Vega: How big is the drop? Any errors in logs?

Maya Rivers: Quick numbers: `7d_calls: 3,200 (was 12,400)`, `7d_tokens: 7.1M (was 28.7M)`, `error_rate: 1.4% (was 0.4%)`, `avg_p95: 580ms (was 340ms)`. No infra deploys on our side in the window.

Priyanka Rao: Support ticket #4921 has customer report: "answers becoming shorter, context lost after 3 turns". I repro'd and saw KV-cache miss rate up; their client downgraded caching to avoid stale responses. Also found a spike in `context-length-exceed` when they started sending image-metadata in the prompt.

Theo Barnes: On the competitive side, FlowGen offers cheaper token pricing at the moment and claims faster p95 under their benchmarking. We should ask Nimbus what metrics they value: cost, p95, quality retention multi-turn?

Maya Rivers: Agreed. Plan: 1) Quick outreach to CTO (or engineering lead) to schedule a 30-min audit; 2) Offer a 10-day focused recovery: infra triage + app patch + quality check; 3) If needed, offer a short Dedicated trial for the busiest route.

Carlos Vega: Draft outreach: "Hi — Maya from Redwood CS. Noticed a usage and quality change during your POC window. Can we do a 30m audit this week? We'll bring a before/after perf and a short remediation plan." Suggest slots Tue 9am PT / Thu 1pm PT.

Priyanka Rao: I'll prep a 6-slide audit: top-errors, KV cache findings, suggested client diffs, token-cost sketch vs FlowGen, and a QA checklist to validate multi-turn context.

Theo Barnes: I'll run a focused bench: their top-10 prompts w/ image-metadata vs without to show context-length effects and p95. Also will simulate client with `max_batch_size: 16` vs `2`.

Maya Rivers: Also flag AE — renewal calendar in 4 weeks. If POC ends poorly we may need an executive check-in.

infra-bot: alert: kv-cache eviction bump detected at 2062222400 — attention: infra team notified.

Carlos Vega: Action owners: Carlos outreach, Priyanka audit slides, Theo bench + repro, infra to validate cache eviction.

Priyanka Rao: Quick note for the audit: include a short diff snippet to re-enable prefix caching and a suggestion to strip image-metadata into a separate attachment to avoid context bloat. Example diff: ```client.config.cache.prefix: true
client.batch.max: 16
```

Maya Rivers: Outreach sent to CTO (cc AE). Auto-reply: "Can do Thu 1pm PT." Tentative booked.

Theo Barnes: Bench result (sanity): enabling prefix cache + batch16 reduced p95 by ~260ms and preserved multi-turn coherence in our harness. I'll add CSV to the slides.

Carlos Vega: Great. On the Thu call we should: 1) confirm evaluation criteria (p95 / mult-turn QA / token budget), 2) show bench numbers, 3) propose 10-day recovery path and Dedicated trial option, 4) agree owners and timing.

Priyanka Rao: Deck uploaded to #cs-decks and linked in the invite.

Maya Rivers: Thanks team. We'll debrief after Thu and decide whether to propose a price concession or pilot extension. Update thread with outcomes. :thumbsup:
